title: The Drug Users Bible (book)

plain_text:
The Drug Users Bible is a 638 page harm reduction tome, the first edition of which was published in 2019. During subsequent years it became the focal point of a collective effort known as The Darknet Harm Reduction Project.   Its initial introduction covered both it's context and content:People are dying because of ignorance. They are dying because unremitting propaganda is denying them vital safety information. They are dying because legislators and the media are censoring the science, and are ruthlessly pushing an ideological agenda instead. They are dying because the first casualty of war is truth, and the war on drugs is no different. This book makes a significant contribution in confronting this harrowing and tragic narrative.

Over a 12 year period the author of this book self-administered over 180 psychoactive substances; both chemicals and plants. For each he recorded the life-sensitive safety data, including the anticipated onset times, the common threshold doses, the routes of administration, and the expected duration of the experience.

In addition, for every compound he also produced a trip report, detailing the qualitative experience itself. This delivered another invaluable insight, enabling, for example, an objective assessment of the extent of any loss of judgement and self-control.

This is a substantial body of work, embracing a wealth of direct support material, including addiction/overdose advice, relative harm tables, and legal briefings. Its contents also extend to cover aspects such as drug tourism, psychedelic exploration and drug related culture. It is crammed with detailed reference data, and even includes its own drug dictionary.

The Drug Users Bible is a unique and unprecedented volume of encyclopaedic research, embracing the full extent of the drugscape. Its objective is to provide, without fear or compromise, core and critical information to support the health, welfare and well-being of the 250 million people in the world who use drugs.

The Darknet Harm Reduction Project

This project was created to embed harm reduction into the fabric of the darknet itself. By 2025 every major darknet market was offering a copy of the PDF version of the book to consumers and customers. The darknet social media platforms, and most darknet directories, also embraced and supported this project.

The History Of The Drug Users Bible

A brief chronology of the major developments regarding this project: 

2008-2017: The author self-administered the drugs, documented each experience, and wrote the paperback edition of The Drug Users Bible. 

2017-2022: Over its three editions the book became an Amazon best seller and widely known within the community. 

2022-2023: In an attempt to reach those drug consumers who didn’t read books, or who couldn’t afford them, a PDF version was created for free-distribution. The first weekend alone yielded almost 20,000 downloads. 

2023-2024: On the basis that vital harm reduction information being provided without charge at point of drug purchase, on a global basis, would have a significant impact upon public health the darknet markets and other infrastructure players were engaged. 

2024-2025: By the end of 2024 the PDF was being provided free-of-charge by almost every significant drug market. 

2024: Also during 2024, a team of Dread staff, contributors and moderators produced a browser based edition of the book, thus distributing its contents even further. This can be viewed on www.DrugUsersBible.org
